property_summary: After initializing with a non-zero changeFee, the buggy version always sets changeFee to 0, so a subsequent call to availableForFlashLoan (which reads changeFee indirectly via flashFee) returns 0 instead of the original non-zero value, causing the test assertion that c.changeFee() != 0 to hold on the reference and fail on the bug.
change_summary: Replace assignment of changeFee with a fixed value of 0.
